preconditions.description: The number of boxes n is between 2 and 10^5 inclusive.
The index x of the box receiving the last ball is between 1 and n inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(a) == n and all(0 <= val <= 10**9 for val in a)
preconditions.description: The input array a has n elements, each representing the final ball count in a box, with values between 0 and 10^9 inclusive.
The box at index x (1-based) has a non-zero number of balls after the operation.

postconditions.description: The minimum value in the final array a is identified, and the difference between the count at index x and this minimum is divisible by n, ensuring a valid number of full cycles.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= b[i] for i in range(n))
postconditions.description: Every element in the reconstructed initial array b is non-negative.
The total number of balls remains constant between the initial and final states.

postconditions.expression: b[i] == a[i] - min_val if i != x-1 else a[i] - min_val - n
postconditions.description: The initial count for each box is derived by subtracting the minimum value from all boxes, and subtracting an additional n from the box at index x, representing the balls taken out and distributed.
